inspectedText: Two cartloads of obsolete tally sticks were burned in underfloor stoves below the Lords. Visitors noticed heat and smoke but work continued. Furnaces extinguished at 5pm; alarm at 6pm. Both chambers and most site buildings destroyed; Westminster Hall and other parts survived. Split tallies served medieval accounting.
